anchor.event: Net FPI flows of -13,600 USD million for March

edges.evidence_span: the rupee is under pressure as exporter payments are not materialising, dollar outflows on account of FPI selling in domestic equity markets continuing
edges.note: Three causes are listed together and FPI selling is one of them. A reviewer must decide whether 'on account of' attributes the pressure to FPI selling directly or only lists it alongside two others.

edges.evidence_span: In March alone, FPIs sold ₹17,686 crore worth of debt-the largest monthly outflow of the year-amid deteriorating sentiment as the rupee weakened to record lows against the backdrop of the West Asia conflict. The rupee has declined over 11% in this fiscal year, while bond yields have risen 55 basis points
edges.note: The passage reports debt outflows and a yield rise in the same window without asserting that one drove the other. Drafted correlational; a reviewer may hold that it supports no edge at all.

edges.evidence_span: A sustained depreciation in the rupee would directly inflate the import bill
edges.note: Hypothetical ('would'), so drafted conditional. Do not upgrade it.

edges.evidence_span: A sustained depreciation in the rupee would directly inflate the import bill, widen both the current account deficit
edges.note: Same sentence as tw3 and tw5. One span, three destinations: check that each destination's move is stated, not just listed.

edges.evidence_span: A sustained depreciation in the rupee would directly inflate the import bill, widen both the current account deficit and fiscal deficit
edges.note: 'widen both the current account deficit and fiscal deficit' - the verb is shared. A reviewer may read the fiscal leg as weaker than the current-account leg.

notes: DRAFT, NOT ADJUDICATED. Spans are sliced verbatim from data/processed/articles.jsonl by scripts/draft_test_gold_graphs.py and each edge passes the B6 rule layer: the span is verbatim in the cited passage, the passage is in the frozen corpus, it was published on or before the query cutoff, and both variables are named in it or in D-17's preceding window. None of that establishes support. No annotator has read these spans, there is no review receipt, and nothing here may be scored as a reference graph until two annotators have labelled every edge independently and blind under D-26 and signed a receipt.
